description_en: Lists the resources or principals that are associated with a resource share
description_zh: 查询共享单元中关联资源或资源使用者的记录
name: ListResourceShareAssociations

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource.

This parameter is not available when `AssociationType` is set to `Target`
parameters.help_zh:
资源ID。
当`AssociationType`为`Target`时，该参数不可用
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the resource.

This parameter is not available when `AssociationType` is set to `Target`
parameters.help_zh:
资源ARN。
当`AssociationType`为`Target`时，该参数不可用
parameters.name: resource_arn

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the principal.

This parameter is not available when `AssociationType` is set to `Resource`
parameters.help_zh:
资源使用者ID。

当`AssociationType`为`Resource`时，该参数不可用
parameters.name: target

parameters.help_en:
The type of the association. Valid values:

`Resource`: Returns associations with shared resources.

`Target`: Returns associations with principals
parameters.help_zh:
关联类型：取值：

Resource：查询关联共享资源的记录。
Target：查询关联资源使用者的记录
parameters.name: association_type

parameters.help_en:
The status of the association. Valid values:

`Associating`: The association is in progress.

`Associated`: The association is established.

`Failed`: The association failed.

`Disassociating`: Disassociation is in progress.

`Disassociated`: The association is removed.

The system automatically deletes records in the `Failed` or `Disassociated` state within 48 to 96 hours
parameters.help_zh:
关联状态。取值：

Associating：关联中。
Associated：已关联。
Failed：关联失败。
Disassociating：分离中。
Disassociated：已分离。

`Failed`和`Disassociated`状态的记录，会在48~96小时内被系统自动删除
parameters.name: association_status

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
单次请求返回结果的最大条数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token for the next page of results. If the previous response was truncated, include this `token` to retrieve the remaining results
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用`NextToken`再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the resource shares.

You can specify up to 5 resource share IDs
parameters.help_zh:
共享单元ID。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多指定5个共享单元
parameters.name: resource_share_ids

NextToken.description_en: The token to retrieve the next page of results. `NextToken` is returned only if the results are truncated. If this parameter is not returned, all results have been retrieved
NextToken.description_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用`NextToken`再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容

ResourceShareAssociations.description_zh: 共享资源或资源使用者信息

items.description_zh: 共享资源或资源使用者信息

AssociationFailedDetails.description_en: Details of a failed association or disassociation
AssociationFailedDetails.description_zh: 关联或解除关联资源或者资源使用者检查失败详细原因

items.description_zh: 关联或解除关联资源或者资源使用者检查失败详细原因

AssociateType.description_en: This parameter is deprecated. Use `OperationType` instead

EntityId.description_en:
The ID of the entity in the failed association.

If the operation involved associating a resource, this is the ID of the principal for which the association failed.

If the operation involved associating a principal, this is the ID of the resource for which the association failed
EntityId.description_zh:
关联实体ID。取值：

当关联类型AssociationType为资源Resource时，该参数为资源使用者ID。
当关联类型AssociationType为资源使用者Target时，该参数为资源ID

EntityType.description_en:
The type of the entity.

If the entity is a resource, this value is the resource type. For more information, see [Services that work with Resource Sharing]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html）.

If the entity is a principal, this value can be `ResourceDirectory`, `Folder`, `Account`, or `Service`
EntityType.description_zh:
关联实体类型。取值：

当关联实体为资源时，该参数为资源类型。更多信息，请参见[支持资源共享的云服务]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html）。
当关联实体为资源使用者时，该参数为`ResourceDirectory`、`Folder`、`Account`或`Service`

FailureDescription.description_en: A detailed description of the association or disassociation failure
FailureDescription.description_zh: 关联或解除关联失败时的详细原因描述
FailureDescription.example: You cannot access the specified resource at this time.

FailureReason.description_en:
The reason for the failed association or disassociation. Valid values:

Unavailable: The sharing operation failed because the resource is unavailable. For example, the resource may have been deleted.

LimitExceeded: The resource has been shared with the maximum number of principals allowed by the Quota.

ZonalResourceInaccessible: The resource is not accessible from the current Region.

InternalError: An internal server error occurred.

UnsupportedOperation: The operation is not supported
FailureReason.description_zh:
关联或解除关联失败时的原因。 取值：
Unavailable：资源不存在等情况导致共享失败。 
LimitExceeded：资源可共享的目标Quota超出上限。 
ZonalResourceInaccessible： 资源在此地域不可用。 
InternalError：服务器内部出现错误。 
UnsupportedOperation：不支持执行操作

OperationType.description_en:
The type of the operation that failed. Valid values:

`Associate`

`Disassociate`
OperationType.description_zh:
操作类型。取值：
Associate：关联。
Disassociate：解除关联

ResourceArn.description_en:
The ARN of the associated resource.

Returned only if `AssociationType` is `Target`
ResourceArn.description_zh:
关联资源ARN。
当`AssociationType`为资源`Resource`时，该参数不可用

Status.description_en: This parameter is deprecated. Use `FailureReason` instead

StatusMessage.description_en: This parameter is deprecated. Use `FailureDescription` instead

AssociationStatus.description_en:
The status of the association. Valid values:

Associating: The association is in progress.

Associated: The association is complete.

Failed: The association failed.

Disassociating: The disassociation is in progress.

Disassociated: The disassociation is complete.

The system automatically deletes associations in the `Failed` or `Disassociated` state within 48 to 96 hours
AssociationStatus.description_zh:
关联状态。取值：

Associating：关联中。
Associated：已关联。
Failed：关联失败。
Disassociating：分离中。
Disassociated：已分离。

`Failed`和`Disassociated`状态的记录，会在48~96小时内被系统自动删除

AssociationStatusMessage.description_en: The reason for the failed association
AssociationStatusMessage.example: The reason for the association failure.

AssociationType.description_en:
The type of the association. Valid values:

`Resource`: The entity is a resource.

`Target`: The entity is a principal
AssociationType.description_zh:
关联类型。取值：

Resource：资源。
Target：资源使用者

CreateTime.description_en:
The time the association was created.

If `AssociationType` is `Resource`, this is the time the resource was associated with the resource share.

If `AssociationType` is `Target`, this is the time the principal was associated with the resource share
CreateTime.description_zh:
关联的时间。存在以下两种情况：

当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源`Resource`时，该参数为添加或移除资源的时间。
当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源使用者`Target`时，该参数为添加或移除资源使用者的时间

EntityId.description_en:
The ID of the associated entity.

If `AssociationType` is `Resource`, this is the resource ID.

If `AssociationType` is `Target`, this is the ID of the principal
EntityId.description_zh:
关联实体ID。取值：

当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源`Resource`时，该参数为资源ID。
当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源使用者`Target`时，该参数为资源使用者ID

EntityType.description_en:
The type of the associated entity.

When the entity is a resource (`AssociationType` is `Resource`), this value is the resource type. For more information, see [Services that work with Resource Sharing]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html）.

When the entity is a principal (`AssociationType` is `Target`), this value is `Account`
EntityType.description_zh:
关联实体类型。取值：

当关联实体为资源时，该参数为资源类型。更多信息，请参见[支持资源共享的云服务]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html）。
当关联实体为资源使用者时，该参数为`Account`

External.description_en:
Indicates whether the principal is an Alibaba Cloud Account that is not a member of your Resource Directory. Valid values:

`true`: The principal is an external Account.

`false`: The principal is a member of your Resource Directory
External.description_zh:
资源使用者是否为资源目录外账号。取值：

true：资源目录外账号。
false：资源目录内账号

ResourceArn.description_en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the associated resource.

Returned only if `AssociationType` is `Resource`
ResourceArn.description_zh:
关联资源ARN。
当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源使用者`Target`时，该参数不可用

ResourceProperty.description_en: The sharing-related properties of the resource

ResourceShareId.description_en: The ID of the resource share

ResourceShareName.description_en: The name of the resource share

TargetProperty.description_en:
The properties of the principal, such as the time period for resource sharing. Valid values for `timeRangeType` include:

timeRange: a specified time period.

day: the whole day.

Returned only if the principal is an Alibaba Cloud service
TargetProperty.description_zh:
资源使用者属性。例如：资源共享的时间段。`timeRangeType`取值：
timeRange：指定时间段。
day：全天。
仅当资源使用者为阿里云服务时返回该参数

UpdateTime.description_en:
The time the association was last updated.

If `AssociationType` is `Resource`, this is the time the resource was updated.

If `AssociationType` is `Target`, this is the time the principal was updated
UpdateTime.description_zh:
更新关联的时间。存在以下两种情况：

当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源`Resource`时，该参数为更新资源的时间。
当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源使用者`Target`时，该参数为更新资源使用者的时间
